idea-plugin.name: Port Manager Veyra
idea-plugin.description:
"Port 3000 is already in use"? Not any more.

Port Manager Veyra shows every port in use on your computer, the program behind it and the project it belongs to, and stops it in one click. No more netstat, lsof or Task Manager.

What you get

  • A live Ports tool window: every listening port, grouped into This Project, Apps & Dev Servers, Editors & Tools and System, refreshed automatically.
  • Knows what's running: recognises 50+ dev servers, runtimes and databases, including Vite, Next.js, Nuxt, Angular, Django, Flask, FastAPI, Rails, Laravel, Spring Boot, Ktor, Quarkus, .NET, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis and Docker.
  • One-click actions: Open in Browser, Copy Address, Stop and Reveal Folder. Double-click a port to open it.
  • Free a Port…: type a port number and stop whatever is holding it.
  • "Your server started": a notification when your project's dev server starts, with Open in Browser and Stop.
  • A status-bar counter of the ports your apps are using.

Safe by design

  • System services, other users' programs and JetBrains IDEs themselves are protected: they are shown, but can never be stopped.
  • Every stop asks first and tells you which other ports the program also frees.
  • Nothing leaves your computer: no account, no telemetry.

Works on Windows, macOS and Linux, in every JetBrains IDE: IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, PhpStorm, Rider, CLion, RubyMine, RustRover and Android Studio.

Open it from View → Tool Windows → Ports, Tools → Show Ports in Use or the status bar.
Made by FlightCoders, the team behind Veyra Studio.
